Contracts.Title: Supply of Desks for Public Schools - Contract
Contracts.Description: This contract outlines the terms for the manufacturing and delivery of 1,000 wooden desks to primary schools within the Lusaka City Council jurisdiction.

Clauses.Title: Scope of Work
Clauses.Text: The Contractor shall manufacture and deliver 1,000 double-seater wooden desks as per the technical specifications provided in the tender document.

Clauses.Title: Quality Standards
Clauses.Text: All desks must be inspected and certified by the Council's Quality Assurance team before final acceptance. Desks not meeting the standard must be replaced at the contractor's expense.

Clauses.Title: Delivery Schedule
Clauses.Text: Delivery shall be made to the designated Council warehouse in Rhodes Park within 90 days from the date of contract execution.

Clauses.Title: Payment Terms
Clauses.Text: A mobilization advance of 30% shall be paid upon signing. The balance of 70% shall be paid within 30 days of successful delivery and certification of all desks.

Contracts.Title: Provincial School Desk Supply Agreement
Contracts.Description: Provincial level agreement for the supply of high-durability school desks to various schools across the Lusaka Province.

Clauses.Title: Object of the Contract
Clauses.Text: Supply and delivery of 2,500 school desks to provincial distribution centers.

Clauses.Title: Delivery and Logistics
Clauses.Text: The contractor is responsible for transport to provincial hubs. Hub managers will sign delivery notes.

Clauses.Title: Warranty
Clauses.Text: All furniture must carry a 24-month manufacturer warranty against structural defects.
